about: The secreta of the formulary “13th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Look with favor upon Your people, O Lord, look with favor upon their gifts; so that, appeased by this offering, You will grant us pardon and give us what we ask. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
